items.title: Theo (@theo)
items.summary: I want you all to tear T3 Code apart. What are we getting wrong? What could we do better?
items.author: theo

items.title: Theo (@theo)
items.summary: Some things I want to improve (most are already in progress): - Long thread load times on mobile - Onboarding in general - Stability of remote updating - Subagent visibility - Configuration centralization - Remote configuration/controls - Storage used by history
items.author: theo

items.title: Theo (@theo)
items.summary: In retrospect it may have been stupid to open source this Theo - t3.gg (@theo) On absolute garbage wifi and running 6 threads in parallel with no issues. This feels like magic. I can close my laptop and be fine, they'll just pop up on my phone T3 Code feels like magic. Thank you to everyone who helped build this. — https://nitter.net/theo/status/2085192524977840243#m
